```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
```

## Summary

Revenue for the week ending `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B")`.

```{r load}
orders <- read.csv("orders.csv")
paid <- orders %>% filter(status == "paid")
```

Paid orders: **`r nrow(paid)`**, revenue **`r sprintf("£%.2f", sum(paid$total))`**.

```{r plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
plot(paid$number, paid$total, type = "b", main = "Paid orders")
```

> Cancelled orders are excluded before totalling.
